band.rule: band_px = round(card_width * 0.07); corners drawn at band_px square, edges stretched along their length only

name_autofit.safe_zone: art window inset by buffer = max(6% of card width, 10px at 236w scale) on each side
name_autofit.base_size: 24px at 236px card width, scale linearly with card width
name_autofit.overflow: if single line will not fit at floor, split into two lines balanced by character count, start at base-2, shrink to hard minimum 12 (8 on minis)
name_autofit.never: text must never render outside the safe zone at any size
